"Science in daily life"

1. Introduction -> It is the age of science. Science has made our life easier and more comfortable. Science play an important role in our dial daily life. Science is nothing, it is a systematic way of knowledge and living.

2. Scientific Inventions -> There are many wonders of science. Science give us many wonderful gifts. Electricity is the most useful and important invention given by science. It gives us light heater, cooler, fans T.V. fridge, computer etc runs by electricity. It also runs machines and trains. Modern life cannot possible without electricity.

3. Means of Communication -> Buses, Cars, Ships, Aeroplanes etc are the greatest invention of science. Man can reach the any part of world within hours, it is possible, only of science.

Now, the man has ab also reached the other planets with the help of science. Nowadays, Everything become possible because of science.

4. Surgery and Medical -> Science give us many wonderful medicines. Vaccination help us to preventing many dangerous diseases, like cholera, polio, small pox etc. Nowadays science has made operation less painful. Todays, the death rate is down.

5. Computers -> Computer is the greatest invention of science. There are many uses of computer, Computer is becoming very essential in every field. Man can solve complex problem easily with the help of computer. Computers can solve our problem within minutes.

6. Conclusion -> If science properly used, it can make the human life more comfortable and easier. Truely, because of science that man is called the master of science. There are also many bad effects of science but We must use science for only good works.

"Good Habits"

We all know that good habits help us to get success in our life. If Good Habits is the key of Success. A good person always gets success in every field. Good Habits means We should get up early in the morning. After that we should do some exersise to keep our health fit and good. There is a good saying that "Health is Wealth". So, Everyone must care of his health. We should take healthy breakfast like - green vegetables, fruits, milk etc. and take proper balance diet. Most important thing of every students that They ought to respect teachers and elders. It is the most important thing that include in the good habits. We should also maintain cleanliness around us because it makes our mind sharp and we feel good. We should make a time table and do everything. We should go to bed early because to get 7 hours sleep is compulsory for us. For this, our mind become fresh in next day. Good Habits are very essential in every life.
